# Format: SRGB|hex(256 little-endian half words, byte 0..255 with alpha 255);
# ALPHA|hex(256 little-endian half words, alpha 0..255); FILE|tag|w|h|hex(RGBA8
# input pixels)|hex(complete EXR file bytes).
# Reference-runtime differential: probe Temp/opencode/exrprobe driving the shipped
# AssetRipper.TextureDecoder.dll `ExrWriter.Write<ColorRGBA<byte>,byte>`
# (SDK 10.0.401). The writer stores premultiplied pixels: each scanline is channel
# planar in chlist order A,B,G,R, alpha stays linear, and RGB passes through the
# sRGB transfer applied to the premultiplied product (byte/255 * alpha/255).
# Rows pin the full 256-value sRGB table, the full 256-value linear alpha table,
# and four complete files (header, offset table, scanline blocks).
SRGB|
ALPHA|
FILE|gray1x1|1|1|808080ff|
FILE|distinct1x1|1|1|01020304|
FILE|redblue2x1|2|1|ff0000ff0000ffff|
FILE|whiteblack1x2|1|2|ffffffff00000000|
